workflow: ad-hoc endpoint resume by scientist-b under REPURP-P3-EARLYBENEFIT-B-20261020; paper_packet.py claim, then the delivered chunks of the artefact already held, read in ascending chunk order
evidence_basis: The surface is a chunked gateway payload delivering 8 of the article's chunks (indices 0, 1, 2, 18, 22, 23, 24, 25); indices 3-17 and 19-21 are absent. Abstract, Introduction, Methods and Table 1 are delivered whole and are declared read. Four Discussion chunks are delivered and were read end to end, but the Discussion as a section is incomplete on this surface, so it is declared not_read and every quotation taken from it names its chunk index; the same conservatism applies to Results, of which only Table 1 and the first sentences of the patient narrative are present. Figure 1 arrives as its legend only, hence captions_only. The reference list is not in the payload at all, hence not_present, and that is why the dependency screen is declared UNSCREENABLE_NO_REFERENCE_LIST in the manifest.

The payload declares 'Summary generated by AI - verify claims against source documents'. No quotation in the manifest is taken from a summary field: all twelve are article text from chunk bodies, and the locators verify byte-exact against the declared derived text artefact.

No lawful new surface exists for this PMID: PMC id conversion answers 'Identifier not found in PMC', OpenAlex reports oa_status closed with no OA location, Unpaywall returns no oa_url. The reading therefore extends the coverage of bytes already held rather than acquiring better ones.
